   1 point : 10% of damage accumulated, up to 50% of Attack Power
   2 points: 20% of damage accumulated, up to 100% of Attack Power
   3 points: 30% of damage accumulated, up to 150% of Attack Power
   4 points: 40% of damage accumulated, up to 200% of Attack Power
   5 points: 50% of damage accumulated, up to 250% of Attack Power
